# 0.6.1 beta 1 — Device operating holds and stable room arrows

- Allow **Minimum device ON time** and **Minimum device OFF time** to be set
  to zero, with one-second increments. These are native device operating
  holds, suitable for configuring radiator valves independently of a
  compressor's required minimum run or restart interval.
- Respect an explicitly edited operating minimum without silently raising
  it to a hidden 120- or 600-second floor. Preserve the other effective
  minimum and the maximum runtime when the first minimum is edited.
- Preserve existing behavior until a minimum is explicitly edited. An ON
  minimum already recorded for the current running cycle completes first;
  later cycles use the selected value. Command confirmation, startup
  readiness, PID sampling and observed transition history remain separate.
- Preserve a selected external supply switch's existing minimums when a
  device operating hold is changed. No additional power-switch controls are
  introduced.
- Keep one room fold/unfold arrow on the right. Toggling a room no longer
  changes its left settings icon into a temporary second arrow.
- Retain all existing releases, their assets and all tags when publishing.
  Remove automatic old-release deletion and reject publisher DELETE requests.

Use the device controller's **Operation** settings to choose the two minimum
times. Zero disables the corresponding HEM operating hold; choose any
manufacturer-required interval for appliances that need one. Existing
settings are not automatically reduced by this update.

Update through HACS, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the dashboard to
load the corrected fold control.
